title: GitHub Bounty Integrity Auditor input
description: Validate public paid-issue listings against their canonical GitHub issue, comments, reward evidence, submitted PRs, maintainer hold-offs, and safety risks.

issueUrls.title: GitHub issue URLs
issueUrls.description: One to 50 public GitHub issue URLs to audit.

includeComments.title: Inspect issue comments
includeComments.description: Inspect public comments for submitted PRs and maintainer hold-off signals.

maxComments.title: Maximum comments per issue
maxComments.description: Maximum number of public comments fetched per issue. Range: 0-100.

githubToken.title: Optional GitHub token
githubToken.description: Optional fine-grained token for a higher API rate limit. Public repositories require no permissions. The value is stored as a secret and is never written to results.
